description: Governor's Office -western Province - Delegation of Powers under Co-operative Secietries
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Hanif Yusoof, Governor of the Western Province) AND detailed delegation of specific powers and responsibilities under the Co-operative Societies Statute. It includes both "who" (the Governor and appointed officials) and "what" (specific statutory powers being delegated to various positions), making it a Hybrid gazette according to the classification rules.
